_readme: Prices in USD per MILLION tokens, keyed by the concrete model id that appears
in the session transcript (e.g. claude-opus-4-8, glm-5.2) — not by the tier or
the alias, because the alias is what a profile remaps and the transcript
This table ships EMPTY on purpose. A wrong number here produces a confident
dollar figure that nobody re-checks, which is the exact failure this pipeline
exists to avoid; a missing number produces `cost_usd: null` next to a complete
token count, which is honest and fixable. Fill it in from your provider's
current pricing page and set `as_of` so a stale table is visible as stale.
Tokens are recorded either way. They are the durable datum (see lib/ledger.sh);
dollars are derived, and derived numbers are only as good as this file.
